flow cytometry.readouts: monocyte subset frequencies (CD14+CD16−, CD14+CD16+), intracellular IL-6, TNF-α, and IL-10 percentages in monocytes

evidence_location.quote: Flow Cytometry On the day of recruitment, freshly isolated PBMCs were surface stained... A cocktail of anti–interleukin 6 (IL-6)... anti–tumor necrosis factor (TNF) α... and anti–interleukin 10 (IL-10)... was used to stain for intracellular cytokines.

hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) assays.readouts: antibody titers against each influenza vaccine strain; 4-fold titer increase used to define vaccine response

evidence_location.quote: Hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) assays were performed... on serum samples collected at day 0 (before vaccination) and day 28 after vaccination to determine antibody titers against each strain in the 2011–2012 vaccine.

Western blot analysis.sample_type: PBMC lysates or purified monocyte lysates
Western blot analysis.readouts: total and phosphorylated STAT3 (Y705, S727) and DUSP1 (S359, S296) protein levels normalized to β-actin

evidence_location.quote: Western Blot Analysis Analysis of PBMCs or purified monocyte lysates harvested at baseline used antibodies against human signal transducer and activator of transcription-3 (STAT3), phosphorylated-STAT3 (p-STAT3) Y705, and p-STAT3 S727... dual-specificity phosphatase 1 (DUSP1)... phospho-DUSP1 (p-DUSP1) S359... and p-DUSP1 S296.
